title: Compose the final answer from verified facts
description: One model call over the verified facts of all sub-questions and the result of the calculation. The answer must go through code.anchor_answer against the facts.

body.system: You are a careful researcher. You answer only from the facts you are given, you quote exactly, and you say "unknown" when they do not suffice.
body.template:
Question:
{{question}}

Facts (each with the sub-question it answers and a quote):
{{facts}}

Calculation (by a program):
{{calculation}}

Write the final answer to the question using ONLY the numbered facts and the calculation. Rules:
- Copy every fact you use as a quote, EXACTLY as written in the fact, and give its number n.
- The calculation was done by a program and is correct: use its result as it is.
- If the facts or the calculation do not give the answer, set status to "unknown" and say briefly which fact is missing. Do not use what you know from memory.
- If facts disagree, say so and give both values with their quotes.

Reply with JSON: {"answer": ..., "status": "answered" | "unknown", "sources": [{"n": fact number, "quote": exact words}]}.
